disclaimer: Source of truth for the original Core commodity/product items, finite regional supplier stock, shapeless crafting recipes and recurring work orders. Run scripts/generate_regional_content.py to regenerate rpg-core resources. Item IDs can be rebound to compatible mod items by datapack once those mods are pinned (see docs/design/recurring-supply-chains.md). Supplier availability is gated by the server-confirmed city region of the placed terminal, not by a client claim.

economy_rules.note: Order credits must exceed the shared-stock purchase price of every consumed commodity by 30%-110%, so recurring jobs earn money but never print it from free goods.

orders.title: Calibrated machine parts for the foundry
Field repair sets for the municipal depot
Precision optic mounts for the licensed range

specials.name: Cannabis Seeds
specials.note: The controlled crop. Planted only by a Farmer who has learned Restricted Cultivation; grown under bright light with nutrient.

specials.name: Cultivation Nutrient
specials.note: Applied by hand to a growing cannabis plant, one dose per growth stage: a real operating cost.

specials.name: Cannabis Flower
specials.note: Harvest only. Contraband in Ironhaven and Valewood; a permitted, licensed trade in Blackwater.

specials.name: Dried Cannabis
specials.note: Two Cannabis Flower dried on a Drying Rack over six minutes of play (D-160). Controlled goods like the flower; a dried product sells for more.

specials.name: Unstamped Plate
specials.note: Machined plating that appears on no register.

specials.name: Bypass Kit
specials.note: One-use tooling for a secured data terminal.

specials.name: Encrypted Ledger
specials.note: Recovered from a secured data terminal by solving its challenge.

specials.name: Heirloom Seed Packet
specials.note: Rare find (abandoned greenhouses, affluent estates, broker contracts). Unpacks into six Rare Seeds: a shortcut worth the exchange price, never a new faucet.

specials.name: Prototype Alloy Ingot
specials.note: Rare find (industrial safes, guard contracts). Unpacks into three Refined Alloy.

specials.name: Circuit Prototype
specials.note: Rare find (office safes, automation contracts). Unpacks into three Control Circuit Boards.

specials.name: Optics Schematic
specials.note: Rare find (corporate safes, brokerage contracts). Unpacks into three Optical Components.

specials.name: Pocket Watch
specials.note: A gold watch on a chain, engraved. Found only in homes somebody broke into; no honest buyer wants it, a fence does (D-125).

specials.name: Savings Tin
specials.note: A painted tin of somebody's savings, kept in a drawer or on a shelf. Found in ordinary homes from the shabbiest up; only a fence buys it (D-172).

specials.name: Seized Shipment
specials.note: A crate under customs tape from the Ironhaven bonded store, wanted back by a broker in Blackwater. Exists only for the thief who took that job (D-173); it is stolen goods at a checkpoint.

specials.name: Silver Cutlery
specials.note: The fork and spoons kept for best. Found in kitchen drawers of ordinary homes; only a fence buys it (D-172).

specials.name: Jewellery Box
specials.note: A lacquered box of rings and a necklace. Found only in affluent homes; only a fence buys it (D-125).

specials.name: Office Laptop
specials.note: An office laptop with its asset tag scratched off. Found only in offices; only a fence buys it (D-125).

specials.name: Pro Pick Set
specials.note: A professional pick and tension set (D-143). Works high-security locks for a thief who has learned Professional Tools; wears with use instead of snapping. Also sold in the cannery den.

specials.name: Wristwatch
specials.note: A steel wristwatch from a bedside drawer. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Gold Ring
specials.note: A plain gold band from a comfortable home's night stand. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Pearl Necklace
specials.note: A string of pearls from a well-off bedroom. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Smartphone
specials.note: A phone left on a night stand or a desk. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Tablet
specials.note: A tablet computer from a home or an office. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Digital Camera
specials.note: A compact camera from a shelf. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Vintage Wine
specials.note: A dusty bottle from a comfortable kitchen. A fence pays well, a Vintner's buyer more (D-144).

specials.name: Rare Vinyl Record
specials.note: A collector's record from a club's deck or a home's shelf. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Designer Handbag
specials.note: A handbag worth more than a month's rent, from a wealthy bedroom. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Cash Box
specials.note: A locked tin of a shop's takings. Credits come only through Q Shop, so a fence pays for the box (D-144).

specials.name: Power Drill
specials.note: A cordless drill from a workshop bench. Only a fence buys it (D-144).

specials.name: Small Painting
specials.note: A small oil painting from a wealthy home. Only a fence buys it, and not cheaply (D-144).

specials.name: Bearer Bonds
specials.note: Paper worth a fortune to the right buyer, found only in exceptional places (D-144).

specials.name: Electronic Scrap
specials.note: Salvaged boards, wire and chips (D-158): stripped from scrap heaps, sold by the salvage yard, found in offices. Three make two circuit boards at an Electronics Bench.

specials.name: Technician's Toolkit
specials.note: A Technician's toolkit (D-158): screwdrivers, a soldering iron and test leads. Opens a utility panel to repair a fault; wears with use. Made at an Electronics Bench; a new Technician starts with one.

specials.name: Engineer's Toolkit
specials.note: A Smith's toolkit (eighth pass): spanners, pullers and a dial gauge. Use it to see the machinery service calls of the city you are in; use it on a machine to strip its drive. Wears with use. A new Smith starts with one; the hardware desk sells them.

specials.name: Diagnostic Scanner
specials.note: Carried during a repair (D-158), it shows at once which half of the circuit has the fault. Made at an Electronics Bench with Municipal Repairs.

specials.name: Flour
specials.note: Milled from wheat at a Mill (D-163). The Valewood bakery buys it by the sack; three wheat make two.

specials.name: Produce Crate
specials.note: Carrots and potatoes sorted and packed at a Grading Table (D-163). Graded Standard, Fine or Reserve; a better table and a trained eye pack better crates, and a buyer pays for the grade.

specials.name: Fruit Crate
specials.note: Apples and berries sorted and packed at a Grading Table (D-163). Graded like a produce crate.

specials.name: Berry Wine
specials.note: Sweet berries, sugar and time in a Fermentation Vat (D-163). Graded; the pub and the bar buy it, and an Oak Cask ages it.

specials.name: Apple Cider
specials.note: Apples and sugar in a Fermentation Vat (D-163). Graded; sold on tap in the pubs.

specials.name: Cask-Aged Wine
specials.note: Berry wine aged in an Oak Cask (D-163). Never below Fine; it keeps the grade of the wine that went in, and a cellar master lifts it to Reserve.

specials.name: Grain Spirit
specials.note: A licensed distiller's clear spirit from a Pot Still (D-163). Spirits are restricted goods: legal to carry with a Distiller's Licence.

specials.name: Moonshine
specials.note: Strong spirit run off the books in a Pot Still (D-163). Restricted goods anywhere without a licence; the back bars pay for it.

specials.name: Fasteners
specials.note: Bolts, nuts and rivets turned at a Machinist's Bench (D-163). Every station upgrade uses them; the builders' yard sells a few.

specials.name: Steel Brackets
specials.note: Bent and drilled brackets from a Machinist's Bench (D-163). Benches, tables and stills are upgraded with them.

specials.name: Barrel Hoops
specials.note: Iron hoops from a Machinist's Bench (D-163). A Vintner's vat and cask need them to be upgraded.

specials.name: Coil Springs
specials.note: Wound springs from a Machinist's Bench (D-163). A Gunsmith's parts kits and benches use them.

specials.name: Gear Set
specials.note: Cut gears on a shaft from a Machinist's Bench (D-163). The top tier of most stations needs one.

specials.name: Bearing Set
specials.note: Two ball bearings in their races, from a Machinist's Bench (eighth pass). A worn bearing in a machine's drive is replaced with one; gearboxes are built on them.

specials.name: Drive Shaft
specials.note: A stepped shaft turned to a drawing at a Machinist's Bench (eighth pass). Graded by how cleanly it was turned; gearboxes and pumps are built around one, and the yard buys them.

specials.name: Gearbox
specials.note: Two gear sets on a turned shaft in a bolted case (eighth pass). A Mill's Geared Crank takes one; so does a pump assembly. It keeps the grade of the shaft it was built on.

specials.name: Pump Assembly
specials.note: A gearbox driving an impeller on its own shaft (eighth pass, Heavy Assembly). The heart of an Irrigation Sprinkler and of the cities' waterworks.

specials.name: Firearm Parts Kit
specials.note: Springs, brackets, fasteners and machined parts fitted and checked at a Gunsmith's Bench (D-163). Graded; the city armoury buys licensed kits.

specials.name: Unmarked Parts Kit
specials.note: A parts kit built around unstamped plate at a Gunsmith's Bench (D-163). Unregistered components; only Dray takes them.
